Stateful random number generator

Source: R/experimental_random.R
experimental_random_stateful_rng.Rd

Ports of jax.experimental.random.stateful_rng and jax.experimental.random.StatefulPRNG: a generator in the style of numpy.random.default_rng whose state updates implicitly. It is a convenience wrapper around the explicit keys of random_key(): the generator holds a key and a counter stored in a reference (see new_ref()); each draw uses random_fold_in(key, counter) and adds one to the counter.

Usage

experimental_random_stateful_rng(seed = NULL, impl = NULL)

experimental_random_StatefulPRNG(base_key, counter)

Arguments

seed

Integer seed. May be NULL at the top level only; the seed is then drawn from R's random number generator (JAX takes it from the operating system), so set.seed() makes it reproducible.

impl

Optional name of the generator implementation (for example "threefry2x32").

base_key

A typed scalar key from random_key().

counter

A reference holding a scalar integer.

Value

A generator (class jax_stateful_prng).

Details

The generator works at the top level and inside jit(), vmap() and grad(), as an argument or as a closed over value. Like any reference it cannot be returned from a function transformed by jit(), so it cannot be a carry of lax_scan() or lax_while_loop().

Methods of the generator rng (sizes are an integer, an integer vector or NULL for the broadcast shape of the parameters; dtype = NULL is the default float or integer dtype):

  • rng$key(shape = integer(0)): a new key, or an array of keys of that shape.

  • rng$random(size = NULL, dtype = NULL): floats in [0, 1).

  • rng$uniform(low = 0, high = 1, size = NULL, dtype = NULL).

  • rng$normal(loc = 0, scale = 1, size = NULL, dtype = NULL).

  • rng$integers(low, high = NULL, size = NULL, dtype = NULL): integers in [low, high), or in [0, low) when high is NULL.

  • rng$split(num): one generator holding num independent children, to pass to vmap().

  • rng$spawn(n_children): a list of independent generators.

rng$base_key and rng$counter give the key and the counter reference (the fields _base_key and _counter of JAX).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rng <- experimental_random_stateful_rng(42)
rng$uniform()
rng$normal(size = 3L)
jit(function(x) x + rng$uniform())(1)
vmap(function(r, x) x + r$uniform())(rng$split(3L), jnp_zeros(3L))
} # }
